meta.why: Removed from the country file: web-checked and confirmed not to be published documents — synthesised meta/framing nodes, geographic areas, industries, projects, institutions. Banned by data spec 2b/2c. Kept here in full so nothing is lost.

reports.title: Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, the riyal peg, foreign-exchange reserves management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.
reports._notes: Central-bank institutional counterpart to GASTAT. Riyal peg is the monetary anchor.

reports.title: Saudi Arabia foundational statistical-system meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and SAMA sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding the GASTAT institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, SAMA institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Saudi research.
reports._notes: Opening integrating node. Oil + Vision 2030 diversification will structure subsequent densification.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch

reports.title: Saudi Arabia oil–fiscal–Vision densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from energy, finance and Vision 2030 sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding crude oil production, oil exports, oil-revenue fiscal dependence and Vision 2030 non-oil diversification into a coherent oil–fiscal–diversification layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the oil–fiscal–Vision densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
National accounts, BOP and SAMA series from Batch 1

reports.title: Saudi Arabia labour–PIF–banking densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from labour, PIF and SAMA sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding labour/Saudization statistics, Public Investment Fund framing, and banking credit/asset-quality statistics into a coherent labour–sovereign-investment–financial layer.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Vision 2030, national accounts and SAMA series from earlier batches

reports.title: GCC Customs Union and single-market framing
reports.publisher: Derived from GCC and national sources
reports.description: Framing of Saudi Arabia’s membership in the Gulf Cooperation Council Customs Union and single market. Common external tariff, free movement of goods within the GCC, and coordinated external trade negotiations are structural features of the external regime.

reports.title: Saudi external economic architecture framing
reports.publisher: Derived from trade and diplomatic sources
reports.description: System-level framing of Saudi Arabia’s external economic architecture: GCC core, WTO membership, active and negotiated free-trade arrangements (via GCC), bilateral investment and energy relationships, and growing non-oil export orientation under Vision 2030.

reports.title: Saudi Arabia GCC–external densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from GCC and trade sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding GCC Customs Union framing, major trade partners, and external economic architecture into a coherent regional and international layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the GCC–external densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil exports, BOP and Vision 2030 series from earlier batches

reports.title: Riyadh region economic and administrative framing
reports.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and regional sources
reports.description: Framing of Riyadh as the capital and dominant administrative, services, finance and Vision 2030 project centre. Concentrates government, headquarters, and a large share of non-oil private-sector activity.

reports.title: Eastern Province economic and oil framing
reports.publisher: Derived from regional and energy sources
reports.description: Framing of the Eastern Province as the principal oil and industrial hub. Hosts the bulk of crude production, refining, petrochemicals and a large share of FDI stock; low unemployment and high household incomes relative to other regions.
reports._notes: Primary oil-province densification. Complements the national oil nodes.

reports.title: Regional economic structure framing
reports.publisher: Derived from GASTAT and spatial sources
reports.description: System-level view of Saudi Arabia’s regional structure: Riyadh as administrative/services core, Eastern Province as oil/industrial core, and secondary poles (Makkah, Madinah, etc.). Continuously cited in Vision 2030 spatial and investment analysis.
reports._notes: Spatial densification frame for the dual capital–oil structure.

reports.title: Saudi Arabia regional densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from regional and spatial sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding Riyadh, Eastern Province and regional-structure framing into a coherent provincial densification layer that complements the oil–Vision 2030 cores.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the regional densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, Vision 2030, labour and PIF series from earlier batches

reports.title: NEOM giga-project framing
reports.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project monitoring sources
reports.description: Framing of NEOM as the flagship Vision 2030 giga-project. Largest share of awarded contracts among the official giga-projects; intended as a new economic and urban pole on the Red Sea / northwest frontier.

reports.title: Red Sea Global / tourism mega-project framing
reports.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project sources
reports.description: Framing of Red Sea Global and related tourism/luxury destination projects. Core component of the Vision 2030 tourism diversification pillar along the western coast.

reports.title: Qiddiya entertainment mega-project framing
reports.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project sources
reports.description: Framing of Qiddiya as the principal entertainment, sports and leisure giga-project near Riyadh. Complements the capital-region densification and the Vision 2030 quality-of-life and tourism pillars.

reports.title: Vision 2030 giga-project portfolio framing
reports.description: System-level framing of the official and broader giga-project portfolio (NEOM, Diriyah, Qiddiya, ROSHN, Red Sea Global and related). Cumulative awarded contracts exceed USD 100 billion; execution prioritisation and capital discipline have become more selective in recent years.
reports._notes: Overall mega-project portfolio densification under Vision 2030.
_referenced_by: NEOM, Red Sea and Qiddiya nodes

reports.title: Saudi Arabia mega-projects densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from Vision 2030 and project sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding NEOM, Red Sea Global, Qiddiya and the broader giga-project portfolio into a coherent mega-projects layer under Vision 2030.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the mega-projects densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Vision 2030, PIF, Riyadh and Eastern Province series from earlier batches

reports.title: Saudi Arabia residual densification meta-node
reports.publisher: Derived from education, health and climate sources
reports.description: Meta-node binding education/literacy, life expectancy/health outcomes, and GHG emissions into a coherent human-capital and climate residual layer.
reports._notes: Integrating node for the residual densification pass.
_referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Vision 2030, labour and oil series from earlier batches
